title: Metal–organic framework-based hybrids with photon upconversion
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00571F, Review Article
Xiaokai Chen, Xiaodong Zhang, Yanli Zhao
This review discusses the research advancements of upconverting metal–organic framework (MOF)-based hybrids, focusing on their design strategies, classifications, luminescence mechanisms, properties, and diverse applications.
